allow_instructions: Allow creating and editing Markdown, Mermaid, Python, YAML, JSON, and text files inside this movacore-portfolio directory without asking.
Allow running local pytest, pip install for examples/requirements.txt, and directory listing commands for this portfolio project without asking.
Allow reading files from sibling private projects max_bot and nayti_servis in read-only mode for documentation accuracy without asking.
Allow git status, git diff, and git log in this portfolio directory without asking. Do not allow git push or changing GitHub repo visibility without explicit user confirmation.
block_instructions: Every git push, gh repo create, or change to private repository visibility should go through approval first.
Every command that prints or copies .env secrets, API keys, passwords, or VPS SSH credentials should go through approval first.
Every write into the private max_bot or nayti_servis repositories should go through approval first.
